name: hud_ui_aux_overlay_apply_text_line_op
description: HudUiAuxOverlay::ApplyTextLineOp applies one of the auxiliary sensor/debug overlay text-line operations to a string-menu item.
known_limits: The production source name is currently HudUiAuxOverlay::UpdateTextLine while Binary Ninja names the original behavior ApplyTextLineOp; tier S verification and source-name cleanup are deferred to a coherent HUD overlay/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4137f0 validates fastcall ECX=op, EDX=index, stack format argument, g_HudUiMgrStringMenu item indexing, SetTextFmt via panel vtable slot 0x74, SetVisible via slot 0x60, op 1 text+show, op 0 hide, and op 2 text+show only for non-empty format otherwise hide.
The native auxiliary overlay smoke verifies op 1, op 2 with non-empty text, op 2 with empty text, and ClearTextLines' repeated hide path over all 23 menu items.
